truthBoundary: Workspace defaults are lower precedence than run config and CLI flags; environment variables are used only for host facts or secrets. Semantic workforce sizing is default-on, bounded at the proven 12-worker tier, recomputed per wave, and remains planning evidence until physical/provider observations exist. Phase 4 planning artifacts are generated by default, digest approval is required only when run config or CLI config sets requirePlanApproval=true, Phase 5 worker progress requires artifact-backed worker execution evidence, Phase 6 completion claims require independent verifier truth, Phase 7 operations-readiness claims require execution-plane ops evidence, and Phase 8 release-candidate claims require cross-repo qualification, observed physical-worker/soak evidence, clean-room replay, and independent release review.
